claim_limitations: compressed-BAO profile score only; no posterior/evidence/significance
no rd or H0 inference because alpha is free
baryon/CDM present-day split exactly unidentifiable from this background distance likelihood
no early-time calibration, radiation/neutrino transfer, or perturbations
not a reproduction of published CMB+DESI+SNIa constraints

contract.alpha_profile: bounded GLS projection of unit-amplitude prediction using full-covariance Cholesky-whitened residual
contract.baryon_split: No CMB/BBN baryon prior; f_b is profiled only by physical feasibility over 0<f_b<f_b_max, where f_b_max=min(1,min_z M(z)/(Omega_m*(1+z)^3)); no background BAO sensitivity to f_b because E depends only on B+C. f_b is not inferred.

bounds_are_search_domain_not_prior.source: Omega_m and alpha from scripts/background_bao.py FIT_BOUNDS; Gamma/H0 from paper Table I IVS box

contract.late_time_reduction: Radiation and neutrino terms in paper Eq.(3) explicitly omitted following BRIEF.md lane A and background_bao.py low-z screening contract; not a full paper-model reproduction
contract.paper_equations: Eqs. (3)-(5),(8), pp.2-4; dot rho_x=Gamma rho_x and dot rho_c+3H rho_c=-Gamma rho_x for w_x=-1; positive Gamma is CDM -> DE
contract.physical_domain: Reject solver failures, nonfinite values, E^2<=0, M<=0, X<=0, or no nonempty positive baryon/CDM split on 0<=z<=2.33
